comment: The polynomials are written out longhand at mrcheb.cpp:80 to :122 and are the standard Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind; a tenth is coded but never called. The range switch scales the input to -1 to 1 or 0 to 1 and the outputs back up by 5 or 10 (mrcheb.cpp:149, :162, :172). The normalisation of the mix is at mrcheb.cpp:181: the sum is divided by the total of the knobs only when that total is above 1.
